data.one_liner: Flutter library containing useful animations for routing.
data.what_it_does: Provides friendly route functions to navigate screens with custom page transitions and animations. Allows building custom animations using a transitionBuilder.
use_when: You need custom route transition animations without complex setup
You want simple function-based navigation for your Flutter app
avoid_when: You need a declarative router with deep linking support
strengths: Simple friendly API with routing functions
Allows building custom animations with transitionBuilder
weaknesses: Limited documentation on all available built-in transition types
Lacks advanced navigation features like nested routing or deep linking out of the box

alternatives.name: go_router
alternatives.why_pick_it: For declarative routing, deep linking, and URL-based navigation.

alternatives.name: auto_route
alternatives.why_pick_it: For strongly-typed route generation and deep linking.
